messages:
mina: customer hit a weird onboarding hiccup. quickstart showed a successful first response during signup, then after adding payment the same container started returning 402 on /v1/generate. console showed "trial credits applied" briefly. anyone recognize this?

carlo: please paste the quickstart env + the failing response headers if you have them. 200 -> 402 usually points to billing webhook timing or token mismatch.

mina: repro from their container:
```
# env per quickstart README
export SAMPLE_QUICKSTART_KEY=sk-temp-abc123
node ./quickstart
```
note: quickstart code reads process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY
first request: 200 OK
later request (after payment): 402 Payment Required
headers: x-request-id=req_onb_01, x-billing-state: verification_pending, x-token-source: provisional
body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"confirm payment method"}
```

carlo: two likely causes we've tracked before: (1) onboarding issues a provisional service account token while the payment processor verifies the card; (2) some quickstarts/docs use SAMPLE_* env names but samples read REDWOOD_* env names, causing users to accidentally run with a different token later. combined these can produce the flip.

ops-bot: created INF-7350: "onboarding quickstart: provisional token + env var mismatch -> 402 after payment" assigned to carlo. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7350

mina: customer workaround: regenerate the service key after payment clears and restart the container; that fixed it. i'll add to KB.

support: update playbook: when a customer reports first-call success then 402, collect x-request-id, org id, which env var they set, and whether they used CLI-created token; suggest regen/rotate + restart as immediate workaround.

carlo: proposed fixes: (a) standardize quickstart env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across repos (owner: carlo, eta: today), (b) add a small preflight /v1/billing_status check in quickstarts to warn if billing_state != active (owner: devex, eta: next week), (c) patch SDK retry policy so 402 is treated as terminal for non-idempotent endpoints (owner: eng-infra, eta: 48h).

devex: will push a tiny preflight snippet to the quickstart repos and update the README to avoid future confusion.

mina: customer confirmed workaround worked; closing loop once docs PR merges.
